bindings.windows: Separate bus/function drivers and a user-mode control/service API
bindings.linux: Separate bus/function drivers and a user-space robotics/control service
bindings.android: Kernel transport plus Android service/HAL only if the target platform is appropriate
bindings.macos: Supported device binding plus application/service layer; no generic robotics driver model
bindings.freertos: Board-specific control tasks, interrupts and bus drivers with safety interlocks

virtualization: Requires a deterministic protocol simulator and safety interlocks; no generic VM profile models a robot.
